ResearchTabDef.label: GeneFoundry
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: After researching xenogenetics, develop biomass extraction, enzymatic recovery and refinement. Extraction is required for both advanced branches.

ResearchProjectDef.label: biomass extraction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build gene vats and extract raw biomass from raw meat, raw plant food and organic corpses. Corpses provide variable recovery based on their size, remaining material and decay.

ResearchProjectDef.label: enzymatic extraction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Use herbal medicine as a catalyst to improve biomass recovery from meat, plants and organic corpses. Corpse catalyst costs scale with body material; all decay stages can be processed.

ResearchProjectDef.label: biomass refinement
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build biomass refineries and raw biomass hoppers. Prepare raw biomass with neutroamine, then allow automated processing to produce refined biomass. Skilled operators and clean rooms reduce failure risk; available gene processors shorten automated processing.
